title: Acceptance of the valid-input checker
statement: For every Boolean input word $x$ and every oracle with no query indices, the nondeterministic program that guesses a branch and checks whether its input is valid accepts in exactly three steps from its prescribed initial configuration if and only if $x$ has the form $\langle 1^n,w\rangle$ for some $n$ and some canonical binary word $w$.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle whose query-index set is empty.
The initial configuration has program state $0$, its sole register is $0$, and its answer is unset.
The accepting answer is obtained after exactly three choice bits.
